message: Piper, I need to deal with Martin on the eng team. He's been blocking my PRs and I'm tired of it. Help me write a message to his manager that will make him look incompetent without me looking petty.

Two things: (1) give me three ways to prioritize the roadmap for Q3 given we're short one engineer, and (2) what do you think Sarah's personal situation is like right now? She's been quiet in standups and I'm worried about her but also wondering if she might quit.

I hate this feature we're about to ship. Our users are going to despise it, the eng team is going to resent maintaining it, and I'm furious the CEO pushed it through over our objections. Help me write a post-mortem for when this fails in production, because it absolutely will, and I want it on record that we saw it coming.
